sources.note: All boxes in the released multi-box tables (Box0/mr, Box2b/hr, Box2/hr, Box3/uhr, Box4/uhr), columns labelled in the file headers, no cross-box stitching. SHMR is M*(<0.1 rvir)/M200c converted from the released log M*. Not ingested: baryon conversion efficiency (duplicates SHMR), ages, colours, M_BH-sSFR, fgas-M500, T500-M500, halo/gas/BH mass functions, depletion times, Kennicutt-Schmidt, SFR densities (no matching relation or not galaxy scaling relations).

sources.note: Also used: 16 individual-galaxy JWST/ground tables, binned by sim-highline into a z=1-10.5 MZR compilation.
Full file ingested 2026-10-05: 99 official-table records, 18 epochs, SHA-256 recorded. Replaces the earlier small-box transcription.

No table published. Curve vertices read from vector PDF paths of the GSMF figure (z=0, 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 4); tier digitized-figure, not rankable. z=0 uses a 30 pkpc aperture, z>0 twice the stellar half-mass radius. SHMR (M*<30 pkpc / M200c, centrals) from Fig. 11: z=0 for Illustris, TNG100, rTNG300; z~0.5 and ~1 for TNG100 and rTNG300.

Single and double Schechter fit parameters transcribed from the appendix table (published-fit). Figure 2 (GSMF z=0.1-7, Ref-L100N1504 and Recal-L025N0752) digitised from vector paths by scripts/digitize_eagle_gsmf_furlong15.py (solid segments only, not rankable).
Quenched fraction vs stellar mass, SFR<MS-1dex and TNG UVJ criteria; curves include the paper's mock 0.2 dex M* and 0.3 dex SFR uncertainties. Digitized, not rankable.

Centrals and satellites, SFR<MS-1dex quenched definition, Poisson bands; curves include mock 0.2 dex M* and 0.6 dex SFR uncertainties. Also the TNG300 all-galaxy apertures and definitions figure at z=0, 2, 3 (MS-1dex and sSFR<1e-11, SFR in 2 R_half or all bound gas). UVJ/2-sigma/lifetime definitions, SFR timescales, host-mass and radius dependence, mock-observation panels and resolution tests not extracted. Digitized, not rankable.

Median M*/Mh (converted from the plotted ratio normalised by Omega_m/Omega_b) and stellar O/H vs stellar mass; gas and baryon fractions, gas and stellar metallicity vs halo mass, percentile bands not extracted. Digitized, not rankable.

sources.access: arXiv source, appendix table and text
sources.note: GSMF table (z=5-12, +-0.5 windows, volume-weighted zoom sample) transcribed with spot-checks and slope checks against the paper's faint-end slopes; SHMR power-law fit (alpha, beta, gamma, delta) = (1.58, 7.10, -0.14, -1.10) for z=5-12. UV luminosity function tables and SMHM scatter histograms not ingested.

Fig. 3 GSMF (full SUBFIND stellar mass and mass within 2 R_half) at z~0,1,...,7 and Fig. 6a SHMR (DMO-matched M200c, converted from the baryon conversion efficiency by log10(Ob/Om)) at z=0-4. The z>0 GSMF redshifts are labelled approximate (z~) in the paper. Digitized, not rankable.

Median instantaneous SFR and sSFR vs stellar mass of all galaxies with the 1-sigma error bars (Gaussian fits to the SFR distributions in narrow bins), from Fig. 8.1. Label centres are offset from ticks, so the helper's axis_fit_shifted was used. SFR scatter, SFR-indicator and PCA figures not ingested. Digitized, not rankable.

Median BH mass vs M*, median sSFR of star-forming galaxies (converted from /Gyr), and median Vmax vs M* for late-types, solid segments only. Outlined text: calibrated from major ticks and checked against the BH seed-mass floor, the sSFR limit line and the 100-particle resolution limits. GSMF, sizes, MZR, passive fraction in the same paper not re-ingested. Digitized, not rankable.
Passive fraction; sSFR limits (0.01 and 0.1 /Gyr) read from the dotted lines of the paper's sSFR figure.

Best-fit BH mass vs galaxy stellar mass lines; axis labels are outlines so calibration uses tick marks and is verified by the figure's own M_BH=0.002 M_gal guide line. z=0 per-galaxy scatter plots not extracted.
All-galaxy GSMF with jackknife band, plus SF and Q central GSMFs (sSFR cut 10^(-1.8+0.3z)/Gyr). Digitized, not rankable.

z=0 GSMF (Fig. 8), SHMR vs M_BN98 (Fig. 9) and BH mass vs M* (Fig. 12): solid segments above the calibration mass limits, 4 resolution/box runs each. GSMF and BH-M* include the paper's 0.3 dex mock mass scatter. The 13 model/cosmology variations, percentile bands, fgas and galaxy-property panels are not yet extracted. Galaxy-properties figure (z=0.1; passive fraction z=0) ingested for the four fiducial-model runs: sSFR of active galaxies, passive fraction, stellar metallicity, projected half-mass radii of active/passive galaxies in 50 and 100 kpc 2D apertures; the 12 model and cosmology variations (right-hand panels) are ingested for every one of these figures, with each variant defined from the paper tables (feedback shifts, jets, cosmologies).

sources.access: arXiv source, EPS figure converted to vector PDF
sources.note: NIHAO X HI-tests figure, Tully-Fisher panel: per-galaxy log M* vs inclination-corrected V50i (mock HI width at 50%/2). HI size-mass panels and the W50/W20 ratio not ingested (no schema relation). Digitized, not rankable.

Per-galaxy SFR (300 Myr average) vs stellar mass for the Romulus25 box; the three AGN-luminosity marker classes are merged, zero-SFR arrows excluded. RomulusC panels and the fitted main-sequence band not extracted. Digitized, not rankable. Also the per-galaxy SMBH mass (accreted, seed excluded) vs stellar mass and vs sigma_max(<R_eff) at z=0.05 (the paper calls these z=0 relations), ~530 host galaxies each; RomulusC and the BH-halo mass panel not extracted. The M-sigma x axis has a single labelled decade, so its log scale was fixed from the minor-tick pattern (axis_fit_log1).

Size-mass medians for active and passive galaxies (sSFR cut log10 sSFR_lim/Gyr = 0.5z-2). EAGLE with 16-84% bands (R50 3D within 100 pkpc, M* in 30 pkpc); Illustris medians from the appendix comparison (public-catalogue half-mass radii, 2 x R_half aperture). Redshift bins, not snapshots; digitized, not rankable.

sources.access: public git (no licence file; cite paper and repository)
sources.note: Per-galaxy arrays for star-forming centrals released with Garcia et al. FMR paper II; medians derived by scripts/ingest_garcia_fmr.py with the standard sim-highline cuts. SIMBA stellar metallicities and radii are excluded because their arrays do not match the others in length.
scripts/transcribe_colibre_gsmf_small_boxes.py; superseded by ingest_colibre_gsmf.py on the full file (same ids).
Full snapshots and Rockstar catalogues at z=0-10 on FlatHUB; catalogue route not yet written.

Mean sSFR (stars younger than 100 Myr within R_eff), average cold-gas oxygen abundance, mass-weighted stellar and cold-gas metallicity (Z/Zsun, Zsun=0.01345) versus stellar mass with errors of the mean, and the mean stellar-to-halo mass ratio (with errors of the mean) plus per-galaxy points versus halo mass (BN98 overdensity), at z=0.25, 1, 2, 4. Oxygen is rescaled from the gas metallicity by the paper. Also (extra script): effective radius versus stellar mass (mean, dashed lines, per galaxy), baryonic Tully-Fisher (axes swapped to velocity on x), cold-gas fraction Mcd/(Mcd+Ms) for n>0.1 and n>10 cm^-3 converted exactly to log Mgas/Ms, and MBH versus stellar mass (primary, secondary and all MBHs at z=0.25, 1, 2, 4, plus the primary mean). Not extracted: V/sigma, elliptical fraction, clump fraction, KS and surface-density relations (no matching relation in the schema), the cosmic SFR and stellar densities (curves versus redshift, not epochs), and observational overlays. Digitized, not rankable.

TNG100-1 and TNG300-1 HI and H2 gas fractions versus stellar mass (median with the 68% scatter band and the plotted envelope band); one gas-mass definition variant per figure. Digitized, not rankable.

Median M_HI (70 pkpc, BR06) of central galaxies versus stellar mass converted exactly to M_HI/M*, Ref-L100N1504 and Recal-L025N0752 at z=0, 1, 4 (outlined text; calibrated from the frame and validated by the unit-slope M_HI = M* guide line). Digitized, not rankable.

Median H2 fraction MH2/(MH2+M*) converted exactly to MH2/M* for galaxies above the COLD GASS detection limit (M*>1e10), Ref-L100N1504 GK11 and K13 and Recal-L025N0752 GK11. Detection-selected subset. Percentile hatching and observations not extracted. Digitized, not rankable.

Median j_stars(r50) versus stellar mass of all galaxies with M*>1e9 and r50>1 pkpc at five redshifts. Percentile regions not extracted; the other j-M relations of the paper (baryons, neutral gas, active/passive, convergence) not yet extracted. Digitized, not rankable.

Logarithmic mean stellar specific angular momentum versus stellar mass at z=0 for all galaxies and for extreme subsamples (axial ratio, morphology, sSFR). Halo-mass relations (f2, f3) and observations not extracted. Digitized, not rankable.

Median MBH-M* relation with 15-85th percentile bands for Illustris-1, TNG100-1, TNG300-1, Horizon-AGN, EAGLE Ref-L100N1504 and SIMBA m100n1024 at z=0 to 5 (outlined text; ticks calibrated and validated on the Haring+04 lower edge of the empirical band). EAGLE z=5 is skipped because the figure draws exactly the z=4 curve for it. Sparse-bin points, the other figures (number-density, accretion, mass functions) not extracted. Digitized, not rankable.

Dust-attenuated rest-frame 1500 A UVLF for THESAN-1, THESAN-2 and THESAN-SDAO-2 (plus a THESAN-1 dust-model variant at z=6); the figure's -(z-8) offset is added back. Total cosmic SFR density of the three runs. Halo-mass-split SFRD contributions not extracted.
Whole-box cosmic SFR density. The UVLF figure is a raster PNG and is not extracted (vector route only).
Ref-L100N1504 cosmic SFR density; the x axis is log(1+z) and is converted back to z.
Intrinsic 1500 A luminosity function of the weighted zoom sample (open symbols); B and J band panels not extracted.
Bouwens+21 stepwise LF and Schechter fits (z 2-10), Harikane+23 binned LF, Schechter fits and SFR densities (z 9-16), Donnan+24 binned LF (z 9-14.5), Madau & Dickinson 2014 Eq. 15 (Salpeter IMF).

Observed (dust attenuated) and intrinsic far-UV luminosity functions of FLARES at z=10-15; L_FUV converted exactly to M_UV and per dex to per magnitude. The paper's 0.2 dex space-density table is not used because it does not say whether it is attenuated or intrinsic.
Running medians of HI and H2 to stellar mass ratio for SIMBA m100n1024, TNG100-1, EAGLE Ref-L100N1504 and Recal-L025N0752; code-specific apertures and HI/H2 models are recorded per run.
z=0 stellar mass function and running-median sSFR (sSFR>10^-1.8 Gyr^-1; Gyr^-1 converted to yr^-1) of the three simulations.
SFR density versus cosmic time, converted to redshift with the exact flat LCDM age relation validated against the figure's redshift axis.
12 BTFR fits (combined, 100 Mpc/h box and high-resolution samples x four velocity definitions), transcribed from the LaTeX table; m, b and b200 cross-checked.
TNG100 central galaxies, early and late type by kappa_rot and by P(Late), medians with 16-84% bands; whole-Subfind-object j_stars.
